component.title: RadioGroup
component.purpose: Collect exactly one choice with native group semantics, clear context, and controlled state.

states.description: A controlled consumer receives the selected value.
An administrator-owned group is unavailable without losing context.

claims.statement: RadioGroup exposes a named radiogroup and native radio inputs sharing one name.
Controlled selection updates the consumer-visible value when a radio is chosen.
Disabled options retain their labels and descriptions while preventing interaction.
